watch.summary: The creator reacts with hilarity to footage of a robot landing a kick in a boxing ring and immediately collapsing face-first.

beats.what: Creator asks how the robot landed a kick and died.
Footage shows the robot kicking and immediately falling flat.
Creator physically reenacts the robot hyping itself up before kicking.
Creator bursts out laughing at his own reenactment.
Creator points out the opponent robot cheering while the other lies motionless.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: How do you land the kick and then die?
watch.why: The physical comedy of a high-tech robot instantly failing and collapsing after landing a move is universally funny. The creator's physical reenactment of the robot's pompous pre-kick routine adds a hilarious layer of personification.
